name: quota-band
description: Your Claude plan's 5h and weekly usage, the context window and the prompt cache's time left, as one line of bars above the prompt

iMessageTo.title: iMessage pings to
iMessageTo.description: Phone number or Apple ID that gets each cache ping as an iMessage from this Mac; empty sends none

keepWarm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepWarm.description: While the thread is idle and the prompt box empty, send a one-word ping about 3 minutes before the 1-hour cache goes cold; never in overage

keepWarmMaxIdle.title: Keep-warm stops after
keepWarmMaxIdle.description: Pings in a row with no prompt of yours (3), or hours since your last prompt (2h)
